title: Kerbal Space Program
description: Design a rocket from parts, then fly it through ascent, orbit, a transfer burn and a powered landing on the Mun, and bring the crew home. Orbital physics punishes every design mistake. A Vals AI benchmark reports Claude Opus 5.5 landing on the Mun and returning in its own harness; it is listed below as an author report, with no timing published.
clear_condition: Land a crewed vessel on the Mun and recover the crew alive on Kerbin.
timing: Run time from the first input in a new save to the recovery dialog, as in speedrun.com's “Mun and Back” category.
rules: KSP 1 (not KSP 2), any 1.x version (state it), no DLC parts unless disclosed. Career or Science mode (state which); Sandbox runs are listed but say so in notes. Launch from a Kerbin launch site. No gameplay mods or autopilots such as MechJeb; telemetry/control APIs such as kRPC go in the Harness track. Reverts must be disclosed under restarts.
